asserts.source:
local alwaysOn = {'BG','BALLAST','RAIL_HI','RAIL_LO','TIE_0','TIE_1','TIE_2','TIE_3','TIE_4','TIE_5','LOCO','WAGON','HUD'}
local frameNames = {'F0','F1','F2','F3','F4','F5'}
local bad = {}
for i = 1, #alwaysOn do
  local c = query.control(alwaysOn[i])
  if c == nil then bad[#bad + 1] = alwaysOn[i] .. '(missing)'
  elseif c.active ~= true then bad[#bad + 1] = alwaysOn[i] .. '(inactive)' end
end
local activeFrames = 0
for i = 1, #frameNames do
  local c = query.control(frameNames[i])
  if c == nil then bad[#bad + 1] = frameNames[i] .. '(missing)'
  elseif c.active then activeFrames = activeFrames + 1 end
end
if activeFrames ~= 1 then bad[#bad + 1] = 'activeFrames=' .. activeFrames end
assert(#bad == 0, 'bad controls: ' .. table.concat(bad, ','))
